name: IC — LDO, 4V — SOT-23-5
description: This cluster contains SMD 4V low-dropout (LDO) regulator ICs in SOT-23-5 packages.
selection_hints: Select when a 4V LDO regulator IC in an SMD SOT-23-5 package is needed.

Use when sourcing parts from Alternate-KiCad-Library.

Voltage requirements differ from 4V or an LDO topology is not needed.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
